name: rainbow-button
title: Rainbow Button
description: An animated button with a rainbow effect.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the button. Override the rainbow with `[--color-1:…]` … `[--color-5:…]` and the speed with `[--speed:4s]`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Solid, or light with a rainbow underline.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the single child element (e.g. a link) with the button's styles instead of a `<button>`.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Native click (falls through to the button).
